heard: NASA is currently shouting into a 24-hour void. Most think our furthest spacecraft is still close to home, but Voyager 1 actually crossed into interstellar space in 2012. It is now 16 billion miles away from the sun. NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory launched the probe back in 1977. To keep it talking, engineers recently fired backup thrusters. These engines had slept unused for over 37 years. It is now a lonely time capsule carrying our golden record. Every radio message must cross that endless 24-hour void.
